AttributeList.Text: Per-valve physical channel assignment, as six parallel flat arrays (one per UDT_Valve_Config field) rather than an array of the struct itself - Openness Import rejects StartValues on struct-typed array elements (confirmed via direct testing 2026-08-13, every encoding tried), while flat arrays of a simple type accept per-index StartValues cleanly, same as Valve_Meta_DB. Populated from the proposed station-by-zone channel assignment (AFT->ET200SP_AFT, ER->MID, FWD->FWD), reviewed and confirmed by the client before this import.
